sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Kyoto Ryokan region of the map, old Kyoto in autumn: wooden ryokan inns, shoji screens, moss gardens, red maples, torii gates and a five-storey pagoda. Region colours: banner #E56B8F to #B03A60, land #B5D18A.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: soft moss-green grass in #B5D18A.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with two fallen red maple leaves.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with two fallen red maple leaves.
Output a square 1024x1024 fully opaque PNG sheet with four exact equal logical quadrants. Use uniform flat moss-green grass #B5D18A for land_a and land_c; land_b and land_d about 12% lighter. Only a few short subtle moss/grass tuft strokes, restrained and readable at 64px. The two lower variants each contain exactly two fallen red maple leaves, positioned differently. Keep every detail at least 8% away from its quadrant edges; borders stay plain moss-green color for seamless repetition. No scenery, trees, gates, buildings, stones, flowers or other props. No gradients, photo textures, texture noise, edge shadows, vignette, outlined square tiles, drawn separators or gutters.

edits.prompt: Make all four ground backgrounds completely uniform flat solid cel colors, removing all soft shading, gradients, mottling, photographic texture and noise. Keep the exact 2x2 layout and all existing grass strokes and maple leaves in their same positions. Top-left and bottom-left background must be solid #B5D18A edge to edge; top-right and bottom-right must be solid pale moss green #CBDCA6 edge to edge. Preserve clean dark-brown leaf outlines and flat red leaf colors. No borders or gutters. Fully opaque square 1024x1024 PNG.
